learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Adequate knowledge of the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework. Organization and management of companies.

teaching_methods: Student study based on different information sources

assessment_methods.method: Class participation, seminars and practical classes

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the partial exam is liberating if a grade equal to or higher than 70% of its value is obtained. All students must take a mandatory final exam. Students who did not liberate the partial subject must repeat it on the same day as the final exam. To pass, students must score at least 4 in each of the two parts of the exam (partial and final material). For the extraordinary call, students who obtained at least 4 in any part of the exam do not have to retake that part. To pass, students must score at least 4 in each of the two parts of the exam (partial and final material) and achieve an average of at least 5.
bibliography: Donnelly. Gibson. Ivancevich. Fundamentos de dirección y administración de empresas. Mc.Graw.Hill.
